description: Every pull-request workflow aggregates its jobs behind one always() check, bounds every job, declares its permissions, names every job readably, and pins third-party actions.
Code health: ts-nocheck, empty skips, `this: any`, runtime console calls, orphan packages.
The model adapter exposes one door (.stream()); only the egress facet may call it.
TSDoc coverage ratchet: the undocumented count may only decrease. Switch to --strict once it reaches zero.
CH11: claimed rule IDs keep a claiming test; scope entries name live rules; new claims are recorded.

Every capability-matrix cell that claims a surface must name a path that exists outside the playground, at least one a test, conformance spec, or example (HB5); the self-test proves a document-only cell fails.
License positioning stays accurate: no stray source-available or commercial wording outside the decision record.
Conformance mirrors stay assignable both ways to the production type they name.
CATALOG.md and the core command registry must agree.
LOC1: referenced `pen.<area>.*` message keys exist in the default catalogs, and every catalog key is referenced or reserved. Diagnostic codes are DOC3's generated table, not this gate.
Published manifests match what sync-package-metadata would write (repository.url, engines.node, files, publishConfig, ./package.json export, LICENSE.md).
Generated envelope table must match baselines/envelope.json. Table diff only; timing lives in bench.yml.
Published packages share one train version and the changesets fixed group lists all of them.
The first-train stamp (peer-promoted 1.0.0 → 0.1.0) fails closed on mixed or surprise versions.
Release workflow is prep-only (version PR, no npm publish) and root `pnpm release` still runs changeset publish.
Docs reference real packages and their samples typecheck.
Published package dependency layers follow the types -> crdt -> core -> extensions DAG.
Installing @input/pen-core must not pull extensions, renderers, or presets.
Every published package exports "." and "./package.json"; extra keys need a reason.
No workspace:* pins or dist re-exports in published manifests.
Each published package README carries the required sections.
The generated envelope table must match its fixture metadata.
Playground, docs, and examples bind unique strict Vite ports so `pnpm dev` does not hop.
